document.text:
Invented visitor-center policy; diagnostic source, not legal guidance.

a. Visitors must register before entering the center.

b. Visitors are not required to wear a badge.

c. Visitors must not carry metal tools inside the center.

d. This policy does not prohibit visitors carrying paper maps. Other building policies may impose additional restrictions.

e. The registration duty in paragraph a does not apply to overnight staff.

f. The metal-tool prohibition in paragraph c does not apply to maintenance workers performing repairs.

g. Maintenance workers may carry metal tools while performing repairs.

h. A delay may occur when the visitor desk is busy.

i. Staff should record the arrival time of each visitor.
